meta.evidence_class: sampled search (random takeover states inside C2) + design rule + certificate (floating point) + simulation

study: takeover-state ensemble inside C2: clearances c_i(0) uniform on the 1 mm grid in [47, 53] m (takeover errors e_i(0) = c_i(0) - 6.5 m in [40.5, 46.5] m), head speed v_1(0) uniform in [10.45, 10.55] m/s (>= v^in = 10.45 m/s), speed increments v_i(0) - v_{i-1}(0) uniform in [[0.02, 0.13], [0.035, 0.17], [0.05, 0.23], [0.065, 0.3]] m/s (4 decimals), seed 7; for every state the dispatcher re-runs the design rule of run_fb_design at the design gain 0.065 (the fixed choices of the design record: T_p 0.25 s, mu 0.02, hold pad 0.5 s, handoff speed 1 m/s, T_pad 2 s, grids q_a, q_c, age bound 20 ms) with the state's c0, v0 and e0, then certifies the shaped reference at 20 ms; draws whose certificate violates C2 (eps_k(0) + Lambda^(1)_k <= 0) are redrawn; two runs per state (zoh 1 kHz: constant 19 ms and random schedule seed 800 + index), compared with the state's certificate (certified only where admitted)
